name: Awkward Moment Seal
look: A close-up photo of a young gray seal with big dark eyes and long whiskers, its head tilted as it glances sideways with an uneasy, awkward expression, against a blurred sandy background.
use: Captures the cringe when a situation turns awkward. The caption describes the uncomfortable thing that just happened, like waving back at someone who wasn't waving at you.
examples: When you wave back at someone
who was waving at the person behind you
When the waiter says 'enjoy your meal'
describe: seal with big eyes looking awkward
uncomfortable seal glancing to the side
baby seal making a cringe face
seal pup tilting its head in an awkward moment
chubby gray seal giving side eye
